fact: On 27 April 2026 Mozambique's Agency for Digital Transformation and Innovation (ATDI) signed a three-year MoU with Ethiopia's FaydaVerse covering digital identity platforms, technical capacity-building for Mozambican specialists and reduction of dependence on external vendors.
title: Ethiopia and Mozambique Sign Three-Year Digital Identity and DPI Cooperation Agreement Linking FaydaVerse with ATDI
